intelligence.title: Paying Twice for Nothing
intelligence.essence: Shawn's thesis, held since 2026-10-10 and spoken as law 2026-10-20: AI waste is the number one problem in the world. The world spends roughly $4.1B/day (2025) rising to ~$7.1B/day (2026) on AI, and a large share produces nothing usable - and valueless output is not zero, it leaves a mess the world pays a second time to clean. Mechanism: producing is nearly free, finishing is expensive, verifying is most expensive, so the world optimized the cheap part. Five waste-manufacturing moves: starting rewarded while finishing unmetered; nothing owns closing; creation outruns the finish line; compliance substitutes for outcomes; no report prints the pile.

connections.note: AI waste is the global-scale case of the completion doctrine: valueless output plus cleanup debt.
